activity_summary: At four o'clock the torches were on the stage, a small figure lay on the tomb-bier, and the yard's faces were lifted. This is the picture of the light being brought. It is not a different tomb from the one just played.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Was on the stage side of the picture, and not yet the Prince in this instant.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Lay as the small figure on the bier.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Was the man the light had been brought for.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Mentioned in Torches, and the bier

facets.activity: Saw the torches brought and the figure on the bier
